name: Justice in the Dark
description: In the year 253 of the Neo-Civilization, Captain Luo Weizhao and Pei Su investigates a series of crimes tied to the controversial "Apaths," uncovering a deeper conspiracy that challenges society's beliefs about morality, free will, and the power of hope.

videos.title: Incident
videos.overview: In a crime-heavy district of Xizhou, the body of a young man is discovered. Special Investigation Division (SID) officer Luo Weizhao arrives at the scene, where suspicions arise linking this to previous drug-related cases. The scene also draws the attention of Pei Su, the young president of the Pei Group.

videos.title: Conditions of Intervention
videos.overview: Luo Weizhao’s team identifies a suspect, Zhang Donglan, who is connected to a high-profile group and the SID chief. Pei Su, with his own ties to the case, undergoes questioning.

videos.title: Informant
videos.overview: An anonymous tipster, Chen Zhen, implicates a drug ring in his sister’s death. Tension escalates when the victim’s mother confronts Zhang Donglan after his release.

videos.title: Portrait of My Mother
videos.overview: A raid on a nightclub uncovers new evidence. A crucial clue from a surveillance camera refocuses the investigation.

videos.title: Where Does Conceit End Up?
videos.overview: The suspect's alias and tragic past come to light. Luo Weizhao takes a more personal approach to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Peeping Gaze
videos.overview: While celebrating a birthday, Pei Su notices a mysterious gaze following a child — hinting at a new threat.

videos.title: Repro
videos.overview: A new case involving a missing girl echoes a cold case from 16 years ago. Luo Weizhao revisits the father of a past victim for leads.

videos.title: The Next Target
videos.overview: A girl vanishes during Pei Su’s birthday dinner. The team connects her disappearance to a survivor of a similar past case.

videos.title: Enchanted Madness
videos.overview: Clues lead to a chilling diary found with human remains. A twisted relationship and dark secrets emerge.

videos.title: Intern
videos.overview: The investigation uncovers new truths about a cold case, and two new interns, including Pei Su, join the SID

videos.title: Behind the Fame
videos.overview: A corporate heir is kidnapped. Family secrets and power struggles within the Zhou Group surface.

videos.title: Whispers of Revenge
videos.overview: A shocking package from the past revives questions about a suspicious death. The SID follows new leads.

videos.title: That Day Forever
videos.overview: A series of deaths and a fire point to a larger conspiracy. Pei Su and Luo Weizhao uncover secrets buried in Pei’s childhood home.

videos.title: The Mechanism of the Accident
videos.overview: As suspects flee, more details about the Zhou Group’s shady rise to power are exposed.

videos.title: The Voice That Splits the Light
videos.overview: A car explosion puts Pei Su’s life at risk. The SID closes in on a shadowy figure.

videos.title: Conversations in the Dusk
videos.overview: Pei Su recovers in the hospital and begins to trust Luo. A mysterious visitor brings insight into Pei’s past.

videos.title: A Final Message from the Mentor
videos.overview: Luo receives a cryptic letter from his late mentor. A new case begins as five students disappear.

videos.title: Unfathomable Footsteps
videos.overview: A mutilated body is found. Surveillance footage identifies a long-wanted criminal from the "327 Case".

videos.title: Their Order
videos.overview: A student reveals a hidden hierarchy of abuse within a boarding school.

videos.title: The Roots of Trust
videos.overview: Interrogation reveals manipulation and cover-ups. A victim tried to expose systemic violence before his death.

videos.title: Exchange of Sincerity
videos.overview: Trust is tested as Pei Su speculates he might be the "Purifier". Luo Weizhao affirms his belief in Pei.

videos.title: Pursuit
videos.overview: The team traces surveillance footage to uncover the criminal’s hideout.

videos.title: Pursuit
videos.overview: A drone-supported raid leads to the discovery of a planted bomb — an ominous escalation.

videos.title: Into a New Chapter
videos.overview: Old injustices resurface. Luo Weizhao uncovers secrets tied to the notorious Seine Riverside case.

videos.title: Emerging Structure
videos.overview: The team discovers the star witness was impersonated. The SID suspects an internal leak.

videos.title: Tracing Memory
videos.overview: Pei Su delves into his subconscious for answers, learning the identity of a missing professor.

videos.title: The Mole
videos.overview: A bug is found on an SID member. Pei Su and others suspect a high-level traitor.

videos.title: Connected Pieces
videos.overview: A repressed memory reveals a key player in past cases. A shocking disappearance changes the game.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: All forces converge at an abandoned mansion — the site of a past murder. Loyalties are tested.

videos.title: Beyond the Darkness
videos.overview: The final confrontation forces a life-or-death decision. Pei Su and Luo Weizhao face the ultimate moral challenge.
